verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents a public GraphQL API, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask. The evidence explicitly says there is no versioning page. The only lifecycle text is a note on migrating legacy API keys to service accounts, which is a credential change, not a deprecation policy for API versions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
